g.text: SW1 selects EN_3V3: ON = PFET via R31; OFF = GND.

g.desc: SW1 selects EN_3V3: ON = PFET via R31; OFF = GND.

g.text: Battery current bypasses SW1; this is standby, not battery isolation.

g.desc: Battery current bypasses SW1; this is standby, not battery isolation.

g.text: OLED: GPIO41 = power, GPIO11 = bus connect (both default OFF).

g.desc: OLED: GPIO41 = power, GPIO11 = bus connect (both default OFF).

g.text: ON: GPIO41 high, wait for supply, GPIO11 high. OFF: GPIO11 low, then GPIO41 low.

g.desc: ON: GPIO41 high, wait for supply, GPIO11 high. OFF: GPIO11 low, then GPIO41 low.

g.text: J4 order: GND / switched 3V3 / SCL / SDA. Verify display pinout.

g.desc: J4 order: GND / switched 3V3 / SCL / SDA. Verify display pinout.

g.text: DESIGN REVIEW 2026-09-04 | Prototype; battery/load and enclosure pending confirmation.

g.desc: DESIGN REVIEW 2026-09-04 | Prototype; battery/load and enclosure pending confirmation.

g.text: TPS63070: PS/SYNC HIGH = power save (both rails). 3.31V / 4.985V nominal.

g.desc: TPS63070: PS/SYNC HIGH = power save (both rails). 3.31V / 4.985V nominal.

g.text: Cold start requires >=3.0V at converter input. JST-PH input rated 2A with specified wire.

g.desc: Cold start requires >=3.0V at converter input. JST-PH input rated 2A with specified wire.

g.text: USB is data-only: VBUS supplies ESD bias only. R11 DNP for low standby current.

g.desc: USB is data-only: VBUS supplies ESD bias only. R11 DNP for low standby current.

g.text: RTC backup/trickle charge OFF; time is lost when main power is off.

g.desc: RTC backup/trickle charge OFF; time is lost when main power is off.

g.text: Capacitance must be checked after DC bias; inspect review/design-review.md before fabrication.

g.desc: Capacitance must be checked after DC bias; inspect review/design-review.md before fabrication.

g.text: Routing GPIO map: BCLK=47, LRCLK=48, DIN=14; OLED power=41.

g.desc: Routing GPIO map: BCLK=47, LRCLK=48, DIN=14; OLED power=41.

g.text: Other assigned GPIOs retained; firmware changes in review/gpio-map.csv.

g.desc: Other assigned GPIOs retained; firmware changes in review/gpio-map.csv.

g.text: D2: common anode at 3V3; RGB GPIO LOW = ON.

g.desc: D2: common anode at 3V3; RGB GPIO LOW = ON.
